import { pick } from './lang'

// Every word the replay shows, in English and in Turkish (MODZ_LANG=tr). Read at draw time through `words()`:
// the language is set when the session starts, after this module loaded.

// English counts take a plural; Turkish keeps the noun as it is after a number.
const count = (n: number, one: string, many: string): string => `${n} ${n === 1 ? one : many}`

  commandEmpty: 'Replay: no edits yet.',
  justNow: 'just now',
  minutesAgo: (n: number) => `${n}m ago`,
  hoursAgo: (n: number) => `${n}h ago`,
  daysAgo: (n: number) => `${n}d ago`,
  prev: 'Previous',
  next: 'Next',
  finish: 'Finish',
  close: 'Close',
  unknownFile: '(unknown file)',
  replaceAll: 'replace all',
  editOf: (k: number, total: number) => `edit ${k}/${total}`,
  newFile: 'new file',
  rewrite: 'rewrite',
  emptyLead: 'No edits yet',
  emptyRest: 'When Claude finishes a turn that edits files, its steps play here.',
  editsInFiles: (edits: number, files: number) => `${count(edits, 'edit', 'edits')} in ${count(files, 'file', 'files')}`,
  nowOn: (k: number, name: string) => `now on edit ${k}: ${name}`,
  diffAlt: 'Change: removed and added lines',
  editsAndFiles: (edits: number, files: number) => `${count(edits, 'edit', 'edits')} · ${count(files, 'file', 'files')}`,
  watch: 'Watch the edits',
  orType: 'or type /replay',
  notNow: 'Not now',
  explaining: 'explaining',
  planStep: (index: number, total: number) => `Plan step ${index}/${total}`,
  projectRoot: 'project root',
  editNumber: (k: number, total: number) => `Edit ${k} / ${total}`,
  moreLines: (n: number) => `… ${count(n, 'more line', 'more lines')}`,
  noLineChanges: 'no line changes',
  removed: 'Removed',
  added: 'Added',
  changedWord: 'Changed word',
  unchanged: 'Unchanged',
  linesAdded: (n: number) => `${count(n, 'line', 'lines')} added`,
  removedCount: (n: number) => `${n} removed`,
  inOrder: 'Edits in order',
  earlier: (n: number) => `↑ ${n} earlier`,
  moreEdits: (n: number) => `↓ ${count(n, 'more edit', 'more edits')}`,
  // Browsing earlier turns and sessions, read back from the transcripts.
  turns: 'Turns',
  pastSessions: 'Past sessions',
  thisSession: 'This session',
  watchTurn: 'Watch',
  openSession: 'Open',
  more: 'More',
  turnsTitle: 'Turns with edits',
  sessionsTitle: 'Past sessions',
  sessionsSub: (n: number) => `This project · ${count(n, 'session', 'sessions')}`,
  older: (n: number) => `${count(n, 'older session', 'older sessions')} not listed`,
  turnN: (n: number) => `Turn ${n}`,
  turnsAndEdits: (turns: number, edits: number) => `${count(turns, 'turn', 'turns')} · ${count(edits, 'edit', 'edits')}`,
  noEdits: 'no edits',
  turnCount: (n: number) => count(n, 'turn', 'turns'),
  unreadable: 'transcript not readable',
  reading: 'Reading the transcript…',
  readingSessions: 'Reading sessions…',
  unavailableLead: 'No transcripts to read',
  unavailableRest: 'This session keeps no local transcript, so earlier turns and sessions cannot be read here.',
  noTurnsLead: 'No edits in this session',
  noTurnsRest: 'None of its turns changed a file.',
  cut: 'only the newest part of a very large transcript was read',
  untitled: '(no prompt)',
  spanOnly: 'edited part only',
  beforeUnknown: 'whole file; earlier text not in transcript',

  date: (month: string, day: number, time: string) => `${month} ${day}, ${time}`,

  explainAsk: 'Say what each file change does in one English sentence of at most 10 words.',
  explainForm: 'Write only "<number>: <explanation>" lines and nothing else.',

export type Words = typeof EN
